notes.title: FUMES update v0.12 - Controller support, loot improvements and SALE!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi guys! This update focuses on [b]proper gamepad support[/b] and improvements to loot dropping. Also, everything is on a [b]juicy sale - the game, Supporter Pack and Soundtrack, check it out![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Controller support overhaul[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/af6d5ac95f5f31f46d6e7ea9a7f99a096865e9a4.png"][/img][/p][p]We added controller support to all menus, except skin editor and few things here and there. This means game should be much more playable with [b]controller and on Steam Deck.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]gamepad navigation[/b] to menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]rumble/vibration[/b] for gamepads (can be adjusted in settings).[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing [b]input glyphs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted font sizes on some UI to make text more readable on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Various buttons remapped. Because of this we had to reset controls setting - adjust them if needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Rework of controls remapping UI to make it easier to use.[/p][/*][*][p]Added separate controls categories for gameplay, menus and photo mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Known issue - some times escape needs to be pressed to register a gamepad at the start of the game. Also you might need to clear/adjust bindings in Steam Input.[/p][/*][/list][p]Since we are a small team, we couldn't test too many controllers/systems etc., so [b]let us know if you encounter any problems![/b][/p][p]Also, some of you wondered why our default gamepad mapping is not setup like in most racing games. The reason for that is that we also have shooting, so we had to go for some [b]compromise between driving and TPS games[/b]. That said - feel free to adjust controls to your liking in the settings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/0d3228b2426267fe0f4faa6c0dbf0ff47b1e84cb.png"][/img][/p][h3]Mouse/gamepad smoothing and acceleration settings[/h3][p]We added these in settings as an [b]experiment[/b] - to be honest we are not sure how people like to use them, so let us know if you have any suggestions![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/8132086beece95f26989c16abf15e9bc4db056d5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Where is my auto aim?[/h3][p]Some of you asked for auto aim, which we would love to add since we [b]simply suck[/b] at aiming with gamepads, but this requires much more work, so we skipped it for this update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Steering wheel improvements[/h3][p]Steering wheel got various fixes and tweaks. It's still experimental, but it should be much more usable now. We set up mappings for Logitech G29. Other wheels should work, but they will probably require remapping and adjusting force feedback strength in settings. And to be clear - wheel is not really intended for combat, use it for driving/racing only or together with a mouse. [b]Have fun with experimenting![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Loot changes![/h3][p]Some of you were not happy with how loot works in the game, it felt too grindy or too random. This is something that we will be adjuting with every update, here are related changes from today:[/p][list][*][p][b]Higher chance[/b] of dropping suspensions for car you are currently driving.[/p][/*][*][p]Bossfights loot various buffs and fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Bavarius, Sharknador and Inudstrius loot fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot grades system tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Endgame-only bosses [b]loot increased[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Other changes and fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Various UI tweaks and fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Photo mode camera movement rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for steering wheel causing mouse to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a printer notification for engine ignition.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for wrong count of unlocked Warthog and Bizon skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for wrong Convoy Hijack enemies selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Surgeon Sorrow boss fight difficulty tweaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Some translation fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Controls settings were moved to a separate settings file in saves location.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, one person asked for a key to quickly [b]open a photo mode[/b]. So we added it under a [b]P key[/b]. Feel free to rebind it in settings :)[/p][p][/p][p][i]By the way - demo was also updated with all applicable changes.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]What's next on our radar?[/h3][list][*][p]More fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support for skin editor and text inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck verification.[/p][/*][*][p]...and more... you tell us![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]As always, thank you for playing and your overwhelming support, this means a lot to us![/h3][p][b][i]FUMES[/i][/b] [i]team[/i]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1920430/FUMES/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: FUMES update v.011 is out!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We are extremely grateful for your overwhelming reception of [i][b]FUMES [/b][/i]early access. All of your [b]support[/b], [b]feedback [/b]and [b]reviews mean a lot[/b] to our tiny team!

This small update is focusing on tweaks and fixes... but we also squeezed in some [b]new content[/b]:
[list]
[*]16 new stickers
[*]3 new skins
[*]3 Minescrap equipped enemies
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/ea14563b0c5058302424119af4070b1e68cb34e3.png[/img]
[h3]Stats bar display rework[/h3]

We had to address a major issue - scaling of all stat bars was incorrect. This might look like we changed some stats on some parts, but we didn't - it just that they are now scaled correctly to make it possible to compare them.

[h3]Bugfixes and tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*]Stats bars scaling fix
[*]Gamepad tooltips fixes
[*]Missing loot showcase SFX fix
[*]TPP camera zooming inside Industrius fix
[*]MineScrap not being attached fix
[*]Various honk interactions fixes
[*]Body parts text scaling fix
[*]Fixed upgrade menu not closing when leaving scrapper
[*]Upgrading from maxed out parts for some parts fix
[*]Tracked suspensions glitching inside Industrius fix
[*]Demo achievements fix
[*]Amount of loot from overseer rank bosses increased
[*]Several suspensions (e.g. Warhorse) drop chance increased
[*]Warthog Steiger Skirmish being available too early fix
[*]Steiger Skirmishes loot and difficulty tweaks and fixes
[*]Industrius difficulty tweaks
[*]Minescrap mines lifetime reduced
[*]Rammer and Stopper enemies archetypes occurrence increased
[*]Convoy Activities distance fail state fix + shortened
[*]Convoy Hijack defenders being Cubs only fix
[*]Enemy mines no longer explode upon contact with other enemies
[*]Unitrack Steiger missing skin fix
[*]Missing Flakwagon description translation fix
[*]Missing Convoy Hijack description translation fix
[*]Fixed several issues with Russian localization
[/list]
[i]This update was released for both full and demo.[/i]

What's next for our team:
[list]
[*]More bugfixes and tweaks.
[*]Proper gamepad support.
[*]Achievements.
[/list]
Thank you!
[b][i]FUMES [/i][/b]team

notes.title: FUMES Demo UPDATE v0.07 + Demo REVIEWS are open!
notes.notes:
New demo update is here, it contains a total rework of intro [b]Industrius [/b]boss fight and some general gameplay additions and improvements.

Also, we just activated [b]reviews [/b]on our demo page, so feel free to add a review to support the development!

[h2]Industrius intro boss fight was redesigned[/h2]

Based on your [b]feedback [/b] we adjusted this part of the game. Keep in mind that this is still something that we are actively working on, so it will keep evolving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/8b7b8d6abd6ceeedcc2c95b870640e104e030d37.png[/img]

[h2]Bavarius boss fight overhaul[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/aaab707b768ee98caf80ff06f5fd259ec4b2803a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/309a07a1b2287bf38060614a2b1528e78d223ebe.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Separate parts like towers and tanks that can be destroyed to gain advantage.
[*] A brand new, special artillery area attack.
[*] Driving tweaks for better manoeuvrability.
[/list]

[h2]Free roaming harvesters - they are driving around and collecting fumes from the air[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/9470b7acdde0ab84dd8dd2a6876966cfe07363da.png[/img]

[h2]Cutscenes got a CRT monitor curvature effect[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/e413c3c90b2c3884c3435ebe1b945eb101f10257.png[/img]

[h2]We re-added more destructible props[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/3264b6d9332cc804b485b37979a9d5db268fb82b.png[/img]

[h2]Cargo free roamers got some interactions[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/08ea52d037325f50eeff34e24e1731982397d864.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Reduced possibility of cargo packages creating their own space program.

[h2]UI and car editor changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Parts upgrading UI improvements.
[*] Enemy shouts menu overlap fix.
[*] Boss shouts color fix.
[*] Audio settings position fix.
[*] Various honk interaction fixes.
[*] Health bar target filtering improvements.
[*] Incorrect enemy health bar switching fix.
[*] Loot showcase skipping fixes.
[*] Gear shifting controls remapping fixed.
[*] Trigger controls resetting on death fix.

notes.title: FUMES Demo Major Update v0.06
notes.notes:
[h2]It's time, we are taking part in the Steam Next Fest and we prepared a major demo update.[/h2]

What's new?

[h3]Meet Industrius - a brand new type of a colossus boss fight, in a first couple minutes of the demo. He is... different. Go meet him and tell your friends about it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/a358849837837cf584cb2294b5bfba927a007487.png[/img]
[h3]We added a couple new game modes, like Convoy Defend, Convoy Intercept and Steiger Skirmish.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/7a08831cf09861718ad4d46b17902ceb1c7563ba.jpg[/img]
[h3]Delivery gameplay - equip cargo modules, steal some packages and deliver them to anomaly stations to research new ways of defeating your foes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/0befc5d4edfedcf07141e582c67c5752ba305ded.png[/img]
[h3]Anomalies? Not gonna spoil them, sorry, but here is a screenshot:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/a54e292b63d0c9dd56b287fddbde501f7a484f8c.jpg[/img]

A whole demo got a new flow. It got shorter, but snappier and got more depth.
That's why saves from previous versions had to go, although, your custom skins didn't got deleted - but they are not loaded currently and we will address this in next patches.

[h3]Brand new terrain that includes mountains, narrow passages and deadly drops![/h3]

Due to new terrain performance might be a bit lower on older devices. Let us know if you encounter any major issues!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/7e2e8a7ba67648a6fdab4d6f7c5a8884bdf60d20.jpg[/img]
[h3]Driving physics got a major rework to accommodate new terrain and mud gameplay.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/61b79bd22da155c6f2e937e6a0a77cf75816d32d.jpg[/img]
[h3]We are working on more customization - this update features option to detach certain parts of the car. On top of that, you can detach them from enemies too (but for that you need guns).[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/dde7cb091da24c64d2e027ebc87b9dd526000483.jpg[/img]
[h3]Now you can upgrade weapons, suspensions, bodies and cargo modules to better grades by combining them.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/0b6444ed5d71ff70258d5fb598ab3d2043ae25f3.png[/img]
[h3]Pretty much every part of the game got improvements. For example, this is new scrapper interior:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/2eb4d0bcb3f8d157bbdc804fb2a84ec026abd9b4.png[/img]

Ohh, and we added gazillions of bugs, but we had to ship this update eventually. We wanted to name it a "YOLO update", but it doesn't make sense. In FUMES you live many times. Forever.

[h2]And as always, thank you for your AMAZING support!!![/h2]

FUMES team

notes.title: FUMES DEV LEAK 02
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello mayhem walkers![/h2]

We are working towards major demo update and early access release (more about this at the end). Here are some things that we are working on:

[h3]Tank tracks suspensions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/584e2490c3a1f9c987504c7b4a9a9b057b093d16.gif[/img]

They will offer some unique capabilities like turning quickly and will handle things like [b]mud [/b]much better.

Speaking of which, [b]mud [/b]will offer an additional challenge, because now certain surfaces like mud, roads, snow or steep hills have [b]individual grip properties[/b] that will be handled differently by various suspensions and driving techniques.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/a9603d06d28b94bb8943d3e63be623fa3b4ebb7c.png[/img]

Also, we are improving driving simulation by making sure that each type of drivetrain (FWD/RWD/AWD) feels different. Besides that, we added a differential lock button that might help when exploring steep hills. Or making wheelies with monster trucks.

So [b]steep hills[/b]? As we teased previously, terrain is getting a major rework that will include much more interesting and challenging environments to traverse. Here are some sneak peaks (pun intended): 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/6cb0b40176c80aad4166892882d87ea15e504d6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/3c83797f7d50836ff113b07b6eeae0594e715abd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/06276ceab664b85cbb73eda2def75142af45bb7c.png[/img]

Ok... but FUMES is a car COMBAT game, right? So what about combat?

Basically we are adding stuff like:
[list]
[*] New [b]combat modes[/b], like for example seek and destroy.
[*] [b]Environmental hazards[/b] that can be found and used during fights to obliterate packs of enemies.
[*] Major improvements to balance, enemy AI and all other related things.
[*] New weapons (like mines for example).
[*] And more.
[/list]
Most of these new combat features are not really possible to show on screenshots or GIFs. But we have one that can be shown - [b]detachable parts[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/f4ea6bef2f0615f16efbb9a121feb6ba734bf5f1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/b8dbd508a4f0e90d42a214ea0582bcba0355c0d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/8e89f343a053ee341e8757ce9e7883daa89bf142.png[/img]

Other than that we are exploring new [b]meta progression gameplay[/b], [b]off-road racing[/b] and [b]delivery missions[/b]. Check out our latest trailer to see some of this stuff in action. Simply put, we are trying our best to turn this rather simple and repetitive pre-alpha-like-demo into a proper game.

And, [b]don't tell anyone[/b], but we are adding some big stuff. A stuff that started as a joke at first, but then some of you said[i] just do it[/i]. So we are doing it. And by big I mean this big:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748558/bc122f4dddbca9e5b4a72744a2f86991b109321e.gif[/img]
(you can't see it here but these tracks are actually too tiny for this kind of... thing).

[h3]Okay, so we are working on the game, but the most important question remains - [b]WHEN[/b]?[/h3]

So the good news is that we have a release date, the not-so-good news is that we are not ready to announce it yet, but here is the plan:
[olist]
[*] We will roll a [b]major demo update[/b] - this will feature most of the new stuff mentioned above and some new content, [b]BUT [/b]also, we will [b]disable some stuff[/b] to make it shorter and less repetitive. Basically, it will be much [b]deeper and varied, but smaller[/b]. So new game modes, activities and more gameplay, but less cars, weapons, bosses etc.

Think of it like a transition from current pre-alpha-like-demo into a proper demo of a proper game. It will still offer endless gameplay with much more variety than ever, just less content.

[b]We hope this is a fair deal. Let us know if you have any thoughts about it![/b]

[*] Next step is getting feedback from this new demo and applying it to address major problems and fix gazillion of new bugs that we will obviously introduce.

[*] And after that, [b]early access release[/b]. At this time game will become paid, so we are trying to make sure that it's worth both your time and money. Also, we plan to keep the [b]demo always available[/b].
[/olist]
And BTW we are usually sharing more small dev-leaks on our [url=https://discord.gg/JsrDcDJCK7]Discord server[/url], so feel free to join it if you would like to.

Also, here is our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1920430/discussions/0/4331980041760396757/]F.A.Q.[/url] if you didn't had an opportunity to read it yet.

[h3][b]And as always, thank you so much for your support, wishlisting, telling your friends about the game and obviously for playing![/b][/h3]

[h2]Let the mayhem ride with all of you, passengers![/h2]

notes.title: RUSTMITES is out!

RUSTMITES is out!

It's an "endless chaser" mini game created to thank you for your massive support of FUMES.

Thanks to you we reached 10 000 wishlists on Steam which can be considered a minimum amount of wishlists that allow the game to surpass invisible Steam algorithm gate keeper. Basically it means that if game has this amount of wishlists it will be shown to some people on release instead of being "swept under the rug".

Also, it's our first time with GODOT game engine, which was an interesting experiment.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo patch 0.04.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Scrappers![/h1]

We published [b]patch 0.04.3[/b]. It contains mostly bugfixes and tweaks. Most of them are based on your feedback, [b]so thank you for your support![/b]

What's next?

For the upcoming weeks we will publish the demo on itch.io and try to port it to Linux and macOS. Our testing possibilities on these platforms are quite limited, so support for them should be considered experimental. More on that soon.

Anyway, here is a (boring) list of changes:

[h3]Bug fixes and tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed major bug with enemies being stuck too far from the player.
[*] Fixed boss fury dialog not disappearing.
[*] Scrapper truck ramp made visible from the back.
[*] Increased chance of free-roamer skirmishes.
[*] The opening cutscene has been shortened.
[*] Added Expirator boss skin to loot.
[/list]
[h3]New content and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new rhombus stickers added.
[*] 2 new skins added.
[*] Some skins has been tweaked.
[*] Added new shouts for enemies and bosses.
[/list]
[h3]Combat tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjustment of damage from enemies with rocket launchers.
[*] The number of Auto Shellgun and Shellgun projectiles increase.
[*] Ricochet chance of Auto Shellgun increase.
[*] Crazy Chrome and Cubot bosses difficulty tweak.
[*] Tweaks of follow distance for some enemies.
[*] Tweaks of scatter angle for Rotor, Automat and Auto Shellgun.
[*] Improvements to Bavarius weapons setup.
[/list]
[h3]Settings and UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added gameplay settings to decrease the amount of dust.
[*] Extended render scale setting range to allow supersampling.
[*] Mouse window locking accessibility setting added.
[*] Added a link to press kit in the streamer mode menu.
[*] Wishlist button tweaks.
[*] Quit prompt rework.
[/list]
[h3]Audio tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Automat and Rotor SFX volume tweaks.
[*] Fixed Automat sound to make it more punchy.
[*] Reverb sound effect was decreased.
[/list]
